methodNotes: The comparison is field-specific: absence of a directly readable quarterly fact is inconclusive, not a new verification. Original quarterly release/manual evidence remains controlling for those fields.
Only dimensionless quarterly periods and correct USD/USD-per-share units are considered; annual and cumulative EPS are excluded.
A source-backed exact-accession correction requires the original release identity; fiscal years are not inferred from calendar dates.
The source report does not assert that all issuer releases or future quarters have been ingested. Newly listed TJX Q3 FY2027 remains pending original statement retrieval.
